entities.summary: Conceptia Liliane Dénis Ouinsou, sometimes known by the surname Denis-Ouinsou or Denis epse Ouinsou, was a Beninese lawyer, university educator and politician. She was president of the Constitutional Court of Benin from 1998 to 2008.
